testSuites.name: Smoke
testSuites.description: Screen opens and loads. Run on every deploy; should take minutes.

testSuites.name: Sanity
testSuites.description: One happy path per operation. Run after a small change or hotfix.

testSuites.name: Regression
testSuites.description: The full library. Run before every release.

testSuites.name: Negative
testSuites.description: Invalid input, missing fields, wrong state, deleted records.

testSuites.name: Boundary
testSuites.description: Maximum lengths, size limits, zero/over-limit amounts, rounding.

testSuites.name: Tenant Isolation
testSuites.description: Company A can never see or change Company B data.

testSuites.name: Security
testSuites.description: Authentication, access control, injection, XSS, private data.

testSuites.name: Integration
testSuites.description: External services fail, time out or return unexpected data.

testSuites.name: End-to-End
testSuites.description: Business flows that cross several modules.

testSuites.name: Data Integrity
testSuites.description: Database checks: balances, encryption, links, logs.

testSuites.name: Admin Features
testSuites.description: Admin-only screens: users, roles and access, companies, settings, practice setup, subscription billing.

testSuites.name: Release Critical
testSuites.description: Must pass before any production release.
